title: Inactive DSH history
donor_inventory: Full per-task source attribution remains in #647 docs/plans/pr612-split/tasks.json, sections.json and net-diff.json. Donor exports/commands/projection-State hunks belong to tasks 19/28/29 and were not imported; donor resume create/adopt lifecycle change was deliberately NOT ported (no public proof required for task30; main adopt semantics preserved with a read-only identity precheck).
implementation: DSH read-only history/import/preview reads use session/list (root identity + cwd validation), session/projections (authoritative fixed cut) and session/page (fixed throughSeq pagination); missing/invalid baselines fail without falling back to activating session/follow. New typed provider.sessions.preview.get pages inactive native history newest-first with an opaque cursor bound to provider/nativeID/cwd/throughSeq/beforeSeq; stale, forged or cross-scope cursors are rejected before any native read. Per-provider capability supportsSessionPreview in the provider snapshot gates the UI; method presence is only the host-version gate. Resume keeps main's adopt lifecycle but validates root identity read-only first. No writer creation, activation, prompt or native log mutation from browsing.
acceptance: List/preview/history reads do not start a session or mutate native logs; import/refresh/restart compatibility remains intact. Browser + loopback native fixture smoke audits zero session/create|follow|prompt|selectModel|commands/execute|session/new|session/load requests while browsing inactive entries, fixed cut across pages, and active agent unchanged. Old hosts receive no unsupported requests; old clients keep existing messages.

interface_changes.old: history/import/preview reads subscribed session/follow, whose Web-client opening carries activate:true and can promote cold sessions to active Agents
interface_changes.new: session/list + session/projections + session/page at a fixed throughSeq; no follow fallback; follow remains only on explicit create/resume writer paths
interface_changes.compatibility: no public API removed; installed DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 public endpoint declarations cited in ADR-240

interface_changes.new: additive typed read-only preview method (Operation SessionPreview, Access::Discovery); SDK fetchProviderSessionPreview; host feature importSessionPreview
interface_changes.compatibility: old hosts lack the method and clients gate on the method catalog before sending; old clients ignore additive schemas

interface_changes.new: additive optional supportsSessionPreview (DSH native true, ACP false); UI shows preview only when advertised
separate read-only Eye preview action opens a paged preview sheet; row-press import unchanged; preview never imports/resumes/prompts
interface_changes.compatibility: additive UI; hidden when host method or provider capability is absent
